data.subject: close across CesiumAstro's recent acquisitions
data.body:
Hi Sanjiv,

CesiumAstro's recent acquisitions of Jariet Technologies, 1Aardvark, and a space defense startup bring multiple new entities into the fold. Integrating several companies in quick succession usually adds significant manual overhead to reconciliations, intercompany accounting, and the month-end close.

Block removed 75% of human touchpoints in the accounting close with Zamp's AI agents.

Open to a 20-minute call to discuss how this works?

[Your name]
